meta.name: wordpress
meta.description: Operate connected WordPress sites through the NotFair MCP. Use for WordPress content, posts, pages, media, comments, terms, design, settings, plugins, themes, HTML files, or approved WordPress changes on a NotFair-connected site. Not the local Application-Password CMS setup used by SEO scripts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在对话里管理网站的文章、页面、媒体与站点设置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在经营网站,想不登录后台就能完成日常内容更新
copy.tagline_en: Manage your site's posts, pages, media and settings through chat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a website and want to update it without logging into the admin panel.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先读取插件内的规范文件 wordpress/SKILL.md，并按它作为工作流，操作已接入 NotFair 的 WordPress 站点。读不到该文件时会停下并报告打包错误。
howto.when: 当你要求处理已连接 NotFair 的 WordPress 站点上的内容、插件、主题等，或做已批准的改动时触发。不适用于 SEO 脚本所用的本地 Application-Password CMS 配置。

say.text: 看一下我已连接的 WordPress 站点装了哪些插件
say.note: 它会先读规范工作流再查询

say.text: 在这个站点新建一篇草稿文章
say.note: 按规范工作流创建草稿

say.text: 把这个改动应用到该 WordPress 站点

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude first reads the plugin's canonical wordpress/SKILL.md file and follows it as the active workflow to operate NotFair-connected WordPress sites. If that file can't be read, it stops and reports the packaging error.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to work on content, plugins, themes, or approved changes on a NotFair-connected WordPress site. Not for local Application-Password CMS setups used by SEO scripts.

say_en.text: List the plugins installed on my connected WordPress site
Create a draft post on this WordPress site
